findings.evidence: `rg -n "GaussianIntegral|GaussianPolynomialIntegrable"` shows `HermiteGaussian.lean:7` importing `GaussianIntegral`, `HermiteGaussian.lean:11` importing `GaussianPolynomialIntegrable`, and `GaussianPolynomialIntegrable.lean:7` publicly importing `GaussianIntegral`.
findings.fix: Remove the direct `public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Gaussian.GaussianIntegral` from `HermiteGaussian.lean` and rely on the existing transitive import through `GaussianPolynomialIntegrable`.
findings.issue: `Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Gaussian.GaussianIntegral` is imported directly even though this file also publicly imports `TauCeti.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.GaussianPolynomialIntegrable`, which already publicly imports the same Mathlib module.

summary: The new declarations are now split into natural homes, but the main orthogonality file still carries an evidently redundant direct import.
